The frame header is read byte-by-byte and determines whether the parser will continue deeper into frame decoding.
If the frame is accepted, the decoder enters the fixed-subframe residual path that uses Rice coding.
Residual partition headers are read directly from the bitstream and drive how many residual symbols are expected.
The residual decoder snapshots its current consumed word index before decoding the block.
